The test image shows a tomato **leaf** with:
- Large gray-brown necrotic areas covering most of the leaf
- Fuzzy/velvety texture on the brown areas (suggests spore mass)
- Some green and yellow-green tissue remaining at margins
- Irregular brown lesions

This strongly suggests **Gray Mold** (Botrytis) — the dense velvety gray-brown spore mass is characteristic. Let me confirm with one reference image.

The reference shows early-stage Gray Mold (tan-brown lesions). The test image appears to be a more advanced stage with the characteristic dense grayish-brown spore mass covering most of the leaf — still consistent with Gray Mold (Botrytis). The irregular necrotic lesions, grayish fuzzy texture, and pattern starting from leaf margins all align with Gray Mold description.
